pages.text: ORSA's last-resort beacon. It broadcasts to surviving relay satellites.$(br2)Building one needs the $(bold)ORSA Transponder Schematic$(), a classified document in ORSA wreckage.
$(italic)"We hid the escape plan in a random structure. Also the cafeteria key." -- ORSA Security$()
4 Refined Acheronite, 2 Diamond Blocks, a Thermal Core, a Frozen Heart and a Frozen Atmosphere Shard. A phone call to space. Long distance rates apply.

pages.title: Activation
pages.text: $(li)$(bold)Depth:$() below Y=0$(li)$(bold)Power:$() Geothermal Core within 12 blocks$(li)$(bold)Sky:$() an open shaft straight up, no solid blocks$(li)$(bold)Schematic:$() archived first$(br2)Right-click to start. The broadcast takes about $(bold)100 minutes$().

pages.title: Broadcast
pages.text: A beam rises through the shaft. Pause and resume it from the interface.$(br2)If a condition fails, it pauses with a warning and resumes once fixed.$(br2)The signal clears snow from the shaft. ORSA's most practical feature, designed by accident.
